index.tagline_en: Drawing aids, clan chat, templates, Discord & Telegram sync — does NOT modify the site's code. Uses only the site's own built-in public API. Made by the Russian-speaking Filian community.
index.fair_play_body: This extension does NOT modify the site's source code. Every pixel is placed by your explicit click through the site's own public API — the same endpoint the site UI calls. We read the public tile layer and your existing session cookie (the one the site already set). No patching, no hooking, no WebSocket injection, no captcha bypass. The site's JavaScript runs exactly as the developers shipped it.

install.title: Install
install.tampermonkey_step1: Install Tampermonkey from your browser's store.
install.tampermonkey_step2: Click the userscript link. Tampermonkey opens an install prompt → Install.
install.tampermonkey_step3: Open filianislost.com — the panel pops up top-right.
install.chrome_step3: Click Load unpacked → pick the unzipped folder.
install.firefox_step3: Click Load Temporary Add-on → pick manifest.json.
install.firefox_note: The Firefox build is unsigned — it stays loaded until you restart Firefox. AMO publication is planned.
install.safari_step1: Download extension-safari.zip on macOS and unzip it.
install.safari_step2: Open Terminal and run: xcrun safari-web-extension-converter ./extension-safari
install.safari_step3: Xcode opens with a generated wrapper project — build & run it once to install the extension.
install.safari_step4: In Safari → Settings → Extensions, enable “The Wall Dev”, then open filianislost.com.
install.safari_note: Safari requires a macOS + Xcode wrap and an Apple Developer ID ($99/yr) for App Store distribution. Local development install is free; we ship the raw extension payload, you do the wrap. Works on Safari 16.4+.
